en: Vibrant green pinnate foliage with smooth clean leaf surfaces free of spots or halos

Healthy root system displaying abundant active pinkish Rhizobium nitrogen-fixing nodules

en: Keep soil loose and weed-free around the pegging zone to facilitate smooth pod penetration
Maintain adequate moisture during the critical flowering, pegging, and pod filling phases
Apply recommended dose of gypsum around flowering time to supply essential calcium for pod formation

en: Follow balanced integrated nutrient practices with required micronutrients like boron and zinc
